'''Glass Palace''' was located on the grounds of [[Alaphoe Gardens]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Procopia/Legends|Procopia]]. The luxurious clubhouse was enclosed in a huge, [[Transparisteel/Legends|transparisteel]] dome, after which it was named. The palace had three floors, and housed numerous casinos and bars. The uppermost floor was off-limits to everyone but to those who were members of [[House Cadriaan]].<ref name="LE" />
